supporting_observations.claim: The supplied failures target svc-routes and originate from FILE-COP-01 itself (WorkstationName=FILE-COP-01, address 10.52.20.20); the 4625 events show LogonType 3 and SubStatus 0xc000006a, indicating an incorrect password.

Failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, consistent with the supplied inventory description that RouteSync re-authenticates every minute. Their timing after the scheduled svc-routes password rotation is consistent with the job continuing to use an outdated password.
Domain-controller records corroborate failed authentication for svc-routes, including Kerberos pre-authentication failures (Status=0x18) and NTLM credential validation failures (Status=0xc000006a).

At 14:18, WS-PBECKER-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event for svc-routes targeting FILE-COP-01. This is consistent with the documented manual-update context and approved remote-administration workstation, though the event alone does not establish the purpose or success of the action.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a password-change audit event or RouteSync job/service execution logs.
Event 4648 records use of explicit credentials but does not, by itself, prove authentication succeeded or identify the action's purpose.
The evidence provided does not establish whether the supplied event list is complete or whether a successful logon occurred.
claims_not_established: Whether the scheduled password rotation completed at 13:30 UTC.
Whether or when the RouteSync job was manually updated.
Whether the 14:18 explicit-credentials event was part of that update and whether it succeeded.
Whether any successful authentication or other activity occurred outside the supplied records.
